posts.text:
🚨 THIS BITCOIN INDICATOR HAS MARKED EVERY MAJOR BOTTOM SINCE 2015.

And now, in 2026, Bitcoin is EXACTLY at that historical support line again.

It’s called the Bitcoin Supply in Profit indicator.

It measures the percentage of Bitcoin’s circulating supply that is currently held at a profit.

When this percentage drops significantly, it means more Bitcoin holders are sitting on unrealized losses.

Historically, when this indicator reached its long-term support, Bitcoin was near major market bottoms.

Look what happened after previous signals:

• 2015: Bitcoin rallied +12,193%.
• 2019: Bitcoin rallied +2,129%.
• 2022: Bitcoin rallied +719%.

While everyone is panicking and selling their Bitcoin, this indicator is flashing a potential bottom signal.

If this pattern repeats itself, we could be looking at another MASSIVE Bitcoin accumulation opportunity.
